linux.limitation: 1306x768 source; 350 kbit/s UDP policing with excess drops. Weak presentation is not a >12 fps pass. RTT/path changes and recovery after a backlog-retired generation remain separate gaps.

excluded_observations.fact: Build terminated and original services/network restored. Recovered presentation stopped after 169 valid samples when its owned surface was closed; no FPS pass claimed.
A quality=None state during reconnection triggered an AttributeError in the test driver. Original service restored; no completed recovery pass.

excluded_observations.interpretation: Server retired the video generation for an expired presentation backlog. The driver interrupted observation during recovery. A later connection timeout occurred after cleanup restarted the original service; it does not establish a separate product defect.

excluded_observations.fact: The normal-user ioreg query returned no root session lock flag, so the fixture preflight rejected it. The accidentally started sampler saw no generated pattern and is invalid. Root session observation and local visual review then verified the desktop before the uniquely named successful sample.

One startup failed before reading the script due to test-file ownership; another selection was rejected before task acceptance. Remote task records/build-directory state were inspected; the actual build was started only after user context refresh. The user pause terminated this actual build; the later successful Cargo invocation resumed it.
